sourceFacts.title: MC SUPRINT Replacement for 502 Ink Refill Bottles High Capacity 5 Bottles
bullets: Replacement for 502 Ink Refill Bottles Compatible Printer– Designed for seamless compatibility with Eco Tank ET-2850, ET-3850, ET-4850, ET-15000, ET-2700, ET-2750, ET-2760, ET-2980, ET-2988, ET-3700, ET-3710, ET-3750, ET-3760, ET-3830, ET-3843, ET-3850, ET-3930, ET-3943, ET-3950, ET-4750, ET-4760, ET-4950, ET-4958, ET-7700, ET-7750, ST-2000, ST-3000, ST-4000, ST-C2100, ST-C4100 printer.Just reliable printing from the first page to the last.

Tired of constant ink interruptions? Each black bottle delivers up to 17000 pages, while color bottles yield up to 6500 pages each (5% A4 coverage). High-yield performance means fewer stops, more flow, and uninterrupted productivity for your home or office.

Get More Ink, Print More Pages—Right Out of the Box. No more running to the store for extra bottles. Your package includes replacements for 502 two 140mL Black ink refill bottles, plus cyan, magenta, and yellow 70mL bottles—5 bottles in total. That's high-capacity printing that lasts longer and saves you money from day one.

Our ink bottles adopt sturdy top sealing design that has passed dozens of strict shipping tests, staying completely leak-proof no matter during tossing or transit. Featuring precision pouring ports, they allow you to refill ink easily without spills or splatters. Simply align, pour and start printing effortlessly, keeping your hands, desk and printer fully clean and well-protected all the time.

Colors That Pop, Text That Cuts Through – Whether it's a business proposal, school project, or cherished family photo, experience premium print quality with brilliantly vivid, fade-resistant colors and razor-sharp text precision. Every page looks professionally polished—because your work deserves to stand out.

Quality You Can Trust, Backed by Real Commitment – Every bottle undergoes rigorous quality testing to ensure consistent, reliable performance. We're unwavering in our commitment to you, because your satisfaction isn't just a goal—it's our standard.

Help Is Always One Click Away—24/7 – Questions? Need assistance? Our dedicated technical support team is available around the clock. Simply reach out through Amazon's messaging system by selecting "Ask a question"—we're here to solve problems, not just respond to them.
